summary: After a reboot the root guardian starts a missing base supervisor (tier0 watchdog, health manager, incident orchestrator) by itself when the AI gate cannot answer because the Gateway is down. A reachable gate keeps the decision; a supervisor running from another release still waits for the AI; direct starts are spaced by at least 60 s; a refusal is logged once.
reason: S24 27/10 14:00 reboot: the guardian restarted nothing for 50 minutes and logged nothing. Its restores go through the immune gate, whose models are reached only through the Gateway (GatewayEngineeringTransport, port 18789). The Gateway belongs to the Companion, which only the health manager starts. With the health manager missing the gate always answered unavailable, so nothing could come back without a manual start. Amine approved on 27/10: when the AI is unreachable (Gateway down) the guardian starts a missing supervisor directly; otherwise the AI keeps the decision.

tests.name: installer/termux-lite/test-root-guardian-gate.py
tests.evidence: 4 tests on the real guardian functions with a synthetic gate: a missing supervisor starts when the gate refuses and the Gateway is down; with the Gateway up it is not started and the refusal is logged once over 3 rounds; a supervisor that dies again is not restarted within 60 s; a supervisor running from another script is never replaced without the AI. All 4 fail on the previous guardian.

tests.name: installer/termux-lite/test-immune-action.py
tests.evidence: The guardian keeps its immune_action boundary (needle check unchanged).

capabilities.reason: Recovery behaviour of the root guardian only; no capability, route or scope change.

architecture.reason: Same guardian loop, lock and ensure_supervisor_effect; the Gateway probe is the health manager's /healthz. No new store, daemon, scheduler or retry engine. The immune gate is still asked first on every round.

evidence: Read-only assessment: root guardian script only; no MCP schema, adapter or endpoint changed.

limitations: Full canonical CI on the final GitHub head remains required.
Live proof: reboot of the S24, Samantha back without a manual action (with Amine).
With the Gateway up but providers unreachable (no internet) the gate still decides: nothing is started directly, as decided by Amine.
